questions.title: Pair with Target Sum
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="390" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="390" rx="7" fill="#2b78c5"/><text x="42" y="54" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">1. Pair with Target Sum</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Use two pointers on a sorted array.</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: values = [1, 2, 4, 6, 10], target = 8</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Return the pair or its indices if two values sum to target.</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Do not use a nested loop.</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Target complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">If the sum is too small, move left. If too large, move right.</text></svg>

questions.title: Maximum Sum of K Consecutive Elements
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="390" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="390" rx="7" fill="#f28c28"/><text x="42" y="54" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">2. Maximum Sum of K Consecutive Elements</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Use a fixed-size sliding window.</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2], k = 3</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Output: 9 because 5 + 1 + 3 = 9.</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Do not recompute the whole sum for each window.</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Target complexity: O(n).</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">Subtract the value leaving the window; add the value entering it.</text></svg>

questions.title: Minimum Length Subarray
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="390" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="390" rx="7" fill="#15966f"/><text x="42" y="54" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">3. Minimum Length Subarray</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Use a variable-size sliding window.</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: target = 7, values = [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3]</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Output: 2 because [4, 3] reaches the target.</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">All values are positive integers.</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Find the smallest valid contiguous window.</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">Expand right until valid; then shrink left while it stays valid.</text></svg>

questions.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="390" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="390" rx="7" fill="#7c3aed"/><text x="42" y="54" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">4. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Maintain a valid window with unique characters.</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: abcabcbb</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Output: 3 because abc is the longest valid substring.</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Use a set or dictionary to track characters in the window.</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Target complexity: O(n).</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">When a duplicate appears, move left until the window is valid again.</text></svg>

questions.title: Minimum Window Substring
questions.svg_html: <svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="820" height="390" rx="20" fill="#f8fbff"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="14" height="390" rx="7" fill="#dc2626"/><text x="42" y="54" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#0c4a6e">5. Minimum Window Substring</text><text x="42" y="105" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#16324f">Find the smallest window containing every required character.</text><text x="42" y="143" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Input: s = ADOBECODEBANC, t = ABC</text><text x="42" y="181" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Output: BANC</text><text x="42" y="219" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Repeated characters in t must also be satisfied.</text><text x="42" y="257" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#425b72">Use frequency counts and a variable window.</text><rect x="35" y="330" width="750" height="40" rx="10" fill="#eaf6ff"/><text x="55" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#075985">Challenge: expand until valid, then shrink to the smallest valid window.</text></svg>
